units: <cite ref="Pesachim 107a:7">Pes. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיסְרָן ומֵפִיס</he> this drink is a tempter and then gives pain (Ms. M. <he>ומֵיפֵיס</he>; Ms. O. <he>מייסרן ומיפיס</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01339"><he>פָּסַס</he></cite>; ed. <he>ומפייס</he>, v. infra).—[<he>מפיס מורסא</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01339"><he>פָּסַס</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to break a person’s anger or will, to pacify, persuade, comfort.
units: Shebu. 45ᵃ כדי להָפִיס דעתו וכ׳ in order to satisfy the mind of the employer (to convince him that he was mistaken). Y. ib. VIII, 38ᵈ top; Y. Snh. III, 21ᶜ bot. מצוה להֲפִיסוֹ it is proper to give him (the owner of the lost animal) satisfaction (by stating the cause of the loss); v. Pi.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71a:3">Ab. Zar. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>צא והָפֵס עלי מנת המלך</he> go and satisfy for me the royal taxes (settle for me as best you can), v. <cite ref="M01820"><he>מְנָת</he></cite>.

Sabb. 33ᵃ מי מֵפִיס who will decide (as to the cause of my disease)? Ib. 54ᵃ מי מפיס וכ׳ who will decide which udders are tied up for the purpose of drying them up and which for the purpose of preserving the milk?—Esp. to decide by chance, by drawing lots, counting a certain number &c. (v. פַּיִיס).

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:2">Tam. I, 2</cite> <he>מי שטבל יבוא ויָפִיס</he> let those who have bathed, come and take part in the count of chance; <he>הֵפִיסוּ זכה וכ׳</he> after they have drawn, he who has won, has won (no appeal is permitted).

<cite ref="Yoma 24b:14">Yoma 24ᵇ</cite> <he>למה מְפִיסִין וחוזרין וכ׳</he> why did they draw once and again (why not at once for all the functions to be distributed)? <cite ref="Yoma 24b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>במה מפיסין</he> (Rashi: <he>מפייסין</he>) what garments do they wear when drawing? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:8">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (play on <he>פסים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 37:23">Gen. XXXVII, 23</cite>) <he>שהפיסו עליה וכ׳</he> they drew lots about it (the coat) as to who should carry it to his father &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 23:2">Sabb. XXIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 148b">148ᵇ</cite>) <he>מפיס</he> (<he>אדם</he>) <he>עם וכ׳</he> a man may decide by lot (on the Sabbath) the shares of honor at the table &c.; ib. 149ᵇ; a. e.

senses.gloss: to pacify, conciliate, persuade. Pes. l. c. מְיַסְּרָן ומְפַיֵּיס (that drink) chastises us (gives us pain), and yet is so persuasive (tempting).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 28b:9">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אני יכול לפַיְּיסוֹ בדברים וכ׳</he> I might appease him with words or bribe him with money.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 9b:8">B. Bath. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>כל הנותן … והמְפַיְּיסוֹ בדברים וכ׳</he> he who gives a poor man a coin will be blessed with six blessings, but he who speaks kindly to him, will be blessed with eleven blessings.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:12">Gen. R. s. 93</cite>, end <he>כשם שלא פ׳ … אלא וכ׳</he> as Joseph pacified his brothers only by weeping &c. Y. Snh. l. c. <he>מצוה להפיסו … ואינו מְפַיְּיסוֹ על שקר</he> it is right to satisfy his mind by stating the truth, but one must not do so by a falsehood; Y. Shebu. l. c. <he>מפייסו … אינו מפייסו וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, end <he>נלך ונְפַיֵּיס לגדלת</he>, v. <cite ref="C00230"><he>גַּדֶּלֶת</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>, end <he>ופייליה</he>, read: <he>ופִיְּיסוּהוּ</he> and they appeased him (Nebuchadnezzar).—Part. pass. <he>מְפוּיָּיס</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51:4">Ex. R. s. 51</cite> <he>הריני מפ׳ שמחלת וכ׳</he> I am convinced that thou hast forgiven Israel.

senses.gloss: to be appeased, satisfied, persuaded. Ib. אותה שעה נֵתְפַּיְּיסוּ … על וכ׳ now all Israelites were satisfied with regard to the work of the Tabernacle (that everything was correct).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 33a:2">Ber. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>נתפ׳ אותו השר</he> that prince’s anger was appeased.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>הרי הגורן בא והכל מִתְפַּיְּיסִים בשביל וכ׳</he> when harvesting time comes, all (that now are disputing) will be convinced for whose sake the field has been sown.

<cite ref="Yoma 86b:5">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>ספק מִתְפַּיֵּיס הימנו וכ׳</he> it is doubtful whether he will or will not accept his apology; <he>ספק מתפייס בדברים וכ׳</he> it is doubtful whether he will be appeased by mere words (without demanding a fine or public satisfaction) &c.; a. fr.
